name: WayriCAD BOM Studio
description: Review component fields, stage BOM edits, and export purchasing or assembly tables.
description_full: WayriCAD BOM Studio opens the originating KiCad project for local component review, staged field edits, and purchasing or assembly BOM exports. Three primary views keep the workflow focused; variants, catalogues, checks and other advanced tools remain available. Supports native KiCad field/grouping/format preferences, CSV/XLSX/TSV and reviewed assembler mappings. No automatic purchasing or upload. Native desktop web view with a local browser fallback; first-time dependency setup may require internet access. Linux/macOS native desktop and KiCad 11 acceptance remain unverified. Shared parts catalogue, reusable templates, reviewed native global library registration and plugin-only alternate suggestions are available from BOM workspace.
